race.comment: SHARP SHOCK (11) tough old gelding who can get the better of these after finally coming up with a good gate. Taken back from the outside draw and sprouted wings to finish a close up third over 1500m at this track. Has the class to take this out with Small's 3kg claim. CHESTIME (14) in career best form with the three wins from her last five starts. Three weeks between runs when she shouldered the 58kg as fav for an eye catching third over 1300m at Narromine. Will appreciate the extra ground and weight drop. Each way contender. DANISH PRINCE (9) goes well at this track and trip and will find this more to his liking. Tough ask when he faded in the straight to run eighth in the Bathurst Cup over 1800m. Was a month between runs on that occasion and strips fitter now. HELLFIRE EXPRESS (1) fitter now in a weaker race and ticks a few boxes third up with the claim.
